stem_book: For the adjoining diagram, a uniform triangular lamina ABC is shown, right-angled at B, with AB = 4, BC = 3 and AC = 5. I₁, I₂ and I₃ are its moments of inertia about axes lying along the sides AB, BC and AC respectively. The correct relation between I₁, I₂ and I₃ is: (a) I₁ > I₂ (b) I₂ > I₁ (c) I₃ > I₁ (d) I₃ > I₂
